instructions: Directory, board, appointment and call-summary data come from the operational service; hospital answers and routing decisions come from the knowledge service.

get_doctor_availability.description: Doctor or department working hours qualified by the live availability board for a date. Applies to directory and availability queries. IN, LATE, CANCELLED, NOT_CONFIRMED and UNKNOWN are board statuses; usual hours are independent of live attendance. Ambiguous directory matches return choices. CALLBACK_REQUIRED means the board is UNKNOWN and no appointment can be recorded; callback contact details are recorded in a call summary with CALLBACK_NOTED. A mixed result can contain individual doctors with journey=CALLBACK_ONLY.

parameters.doctorName: Doctor name for directory search, in the caller's original wording; optional.
parameters.doctorId: Directory identifier for a selected doctor; optional alternative to doctorName.
parameters.departmentName: Department or speciality name for directory search; optional.
parameters.departmentId: Directory identifier for a selected department; optional alternative to departmentName.
parameters.date: Required date: 'today' or YYYY-MM-DD. Other relative dates are not accepted.
parameters.session: Optional session label, such as morning or evening, restricting the board scope.
parameters.gender: Optional doctor gender filter: FEMALE or MALE.

manage_booking.description: CREATE, LIST, CANCEL or RESCHEDULE an appointment request. Writes require callerConfirmed=true and trusted call/operation headers. CREATE requires patientName, patientMobile, doctorId or departmentId, and visitDate. LIST/CANCEL/RESCHEDULE require verified caller identity. NOTED means a request is recorded, not a confirmed or reserved time. UNCERTAIN means the write may have committed without a verified result. CALLBACK_REQUIRED means the live board is UNKNOWN and the write was not submitted.

parameters.action: Required action: CREATE, LIST, CANCEL or RESCHEDULE.
parameters.patientName: Required for CREATE: patient name; nonblank, at most 100 characters.
parameters.patientMobile: Required for CREATE: 10-digit contact mobile. This is contact data, not caller authority.
parameters.doctorId: CREATE doctor identifier; doctorId or departmentId is required, but not both.
parameters.departmentId: CREATE department identifier when no individual doctor is selected.
parameters.visitDate: Required for CREATE: visit date in YYYY-MM-DD format, today or later in facility time.
parameters.preferredTime: Optional CREATE preferred time in HH:MM 24-hour format; a request, not a reserved time.
parameters.session: Optional CREATE board session label restricting the selected doctor's availability scope.
parameters.reasonVerbatim: Optional CREATE/CANCEL reason in the caller's original words; forwarded without interpretation.
parameters.appointmentId: Required for CANCEL/RESCHEDULE: identifier of the appointment request.
parameters.newVisitDate: Required for RESCHEDULE: new date in YYYY-MM-DD format, today or later in facility time.
parameters.newPreferredTime: Optional RESCHEDULE preferred time in HH:MM 24-hour format.
parameters.callerConfirmed: Boolean declaring the caller's approval of this write; true is required for CREATE/CANCEL/RESCHEDULE.
parameters.fromDate: Optional LIST lower date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format; past dates are accepted.
parameters.toDate: Optional LIST upper date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format; past dates are accepted.

search_knowledge.description: One knowledge-service request for hospital information or symptom-to-department routing. It does not read availability or change appointments. ANSWERED and CLARIFICATION_NEEDED carry owner-provided text in answer.text. Routing results carry text only in routing.speak, when present. TRANSFER_EMERGENCY means the knowledge service decided the caller needs emergency help; TRANSFER_DESK means desk assistance; CHECK_AVAILABILITY identifies a department in routing.department. NO_ANSWER is an owner decision; COULD_NOT_CHECK is a service failure.

parameters.question: Required original question, untranslated and unsummarised; nonblank, maximum 500 characters.
parameters.language: Required nonblank language code, up to 16 characters; forwarded unchanged to the knowledge service.

record_call_summary.description: Store the completed call's hospital-facing summary. Available only to the lifecycle bearer. Call identity and timing come from trusted headers. CALLBACK_NOTED records callback contact details after UNKNOWN availability; it does not create an appointment or a separate callback task. STORED is a new summary; REPLAYED is the existing result for the same call and payload; UNCERTAIN means persistence could not be verified.

parameters.summaryText: Required nonblank call summary, up to 2000 input characters. Stored text is limited to 500 characters including preserved callback metadata.
parameters.callerName: Caller-provided name; required for CALLBACK_NOTED, optional otherwise.
parameters.callerMobile: Optional caller-provided 10-digit callback number; required for CALLBACK_NOTED. Distinct from caller ID.
parameters.language: Optional call language; en, kn and hi primary codes map to the operational contract. Other codes are omitted upstream.
parameters.doctorId: Optional identifier of the doctor associated with the call.
parameters.appointmentId: Optional identifier of the appointment request associated with the call.
parameters.transferredTo: Optional destination associated with a transfer outcome.
parameters.requestedDate: Optional requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format; preserved in CALLBACK_NOTED summary text when supplied.
